editorial.name: Tranch
editorial.descriptionZh: Tranch 是面向企业的发票到收款平台（已成为 Elite 旗下公司），把 Pay Later、Pay Now、Pay by Card 三种方式做成开票方给客户的可选项，用来加速应收账款。
editorial.takeawayZh: 把一张发票做成右侧可点选的付款卡片
editorial.noteZh: 首屏是黑白线框风：左边一张粗黑描边的大卡片叠着一张虚线卡，写 Invoice to Payment Made Easy 与 Explore Products / Explore Integrations 两枚按钮，下面强调 Tranch, an Elite company, is the invoice to payments platform for enterprises who want to optimize cash flow。右边一张 Pay Services Inc. 的发票示意卡，标题下划着 $100,000 invoice 与 Invoice Title: General Corporate 2025，Payment Types 下三个带图标的分组：Pay Later（Pay your invoice over 2-12 months）、Pay Now（Pay via ACH and Real-time Payments）、Pay by Card（Secure Payment Portal）。顶部横幅写 Tranch joins Elite to offer seamless invoice management and turnkey payment options for law firms.，下方 Tranch is trusted by 排开 Gunderson Dettmer、Paul Hastings、Ashurst Perkins Coie、Akin、Goodwin、Wiggin、Fenwick 一排律所 logo。
editorial.pricing: unknown（只有 Contact Sales 与 Login，正文未给价格；Pay Later 的额度上限写 $500k）

reasons.statement: 首页交付的是 Tranch 自己的付款方式演示卡、产品分区与客户 logo，唯一动作是 Explore Products / Explore Integrations / Contact Sales，没有可下载物；来源是落地页灵感目录 saaslandingpage.com。
http 阶段抓到的是 Cloudflare 拦截页标题 Just a moment...，但浏览器渲染后的 live 文案与截图都是完整的官网内容，按实际渲染结果归产品与公司官网。

facts.evidence: 首屏左侧卡片标题，配文写 Tranch, an Elite company, is the invoice to payments platform for enterprises who want to optimize cash flow。

facts.value: Tranch joins Elite to offer seamless invoice management and turnkey payment options for law firms.

facts.value: Pay Later 给客户最长 2-12 个月分期，额度上限 $500k 且由 Tranch 承担信用风险
facts.evidence: Tranch Products 一段写 Offer flexible payment options to your clients up to $500k, with no credit risk.，发票示意卡上也标 Pay your invoice over 2-12 months。

facts.value: Pay Now：Free instant payment processing via ACH, Fed Now and Faster Payments
facts.evidence: Tranch Products 一条的正文，发票卡上对应 Pay via ACH and Real-time Payments。

facts.value: For Law Firms、For Software Companies、For Accounting Firms、For Marketing Agencies、For Consulting Firms、For Recruitment Agencies
facts.evidence: 导航 Solutions 一段展开的六个行业链接，另有 /solutions/law 等路径。
